senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to join closely; denom. לְבוּשׁ garment, whence] לָבֵשׁ, לָבַשׁ to be dressed; to put on (an undergarment), contrad. to עטף, כסה.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:3:5">Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᵇ</cite> top <he>אדם … לוֹבֵשׁ שחורים ומתעטף וכ׳</he> a defendant before a human court puts on dark clothes and wraps himself in dark clothes, …; <he>אבל ישראל אינו כן אלא לוֹבְשִׁים וכ׳</he> but not so the Israelites (on the New Year), but they put on white (festive) clothes &c.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 17a:12">M. Kat. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>יִלְבַּשׁ שחורים ויתעטף וכ׳</he> let him put on dark clothes &c.; <cite ref="Kiddushin 40a">Kidd. 40ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chagigah 16a">Ḥag. 16ᵃ</cite>.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 75:10">Gen. R. s. 75</cite> <he>לוֹבְשֵׁי ברזל</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 130:15">Yalk. ib. 130</cite> <he>לְבוּשֵׁי</he>, v. <cite ref="B01227"><he>בַּרְזֶל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:22">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>בריאים כדי לִלְבּוֹשׁ וכ׳</he> strong enough to wear helmets &c.; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="L00059"><he>לָבוּשׁ</he></cite>, pl. <he>לְבוּשִׁים</he>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15">Ib.</cite> <he>אחד ערום ואחד ל׳</he> one (the depth) was naked, the other (the earth) was covered (with water). Pesik. Aḥăré, p. 177ᵇ <he>ל׳ לבנים וכ׳</he> clad in white and wrapped in white.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 130:15">Yalk. Gen. 130</cite>, v. supra; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 122a:4">B. Bath. 122ᵃ</cite> <he>מל׳ אורים וכ׳</he> invested with the Urim and Tummim.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 13:5">Tosef. Ohol. XIII, 5</cite> [read with R. S. to Ohol. XII, 4) <he>מלבין שׁהוא מלובש בפיקות</he> a bed frame upholstered with tufts.

senses.gloss: to clothe, invest. Ex. R. l. c. הפשיט … והִלְבִּישָׁהּ לחבירו he caused one slave to take off his garment and the other to put it on.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 14a:4">Sot. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>מה הוא מַלְבִּישׁ … אף אתה הַלְבֵּשׁ וכ׳</he> as He clothes the naked …, so do thou &c. Tanḥ. Ḥayé 3 <he>ומַלְבִּישָׁן כלי זיין וכ׳</he> (not <he>ומלביש</he>) and clothes them in armor &c.
<cite ref="Sotah 14a:4">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 104:1">Ps. CIV, 1</cite>) <he>זה העוז שהִלְבַּשְׁתִּיךָ בים</he> that is the strength with which I invested thee at the Red Sea.
<cite ref="Psalms 104:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מהודך והדרך הִלְבַּשְׁתָּ לראשו וכ׳</he> part of thy glory and majesty hast thou put on Abraham’s head by granting him the dignity of old age.

<cite ref="Yoma 5b:7">Yoma 5ᵇ</cite> <he>כיצד הִלְבִּישָׁן</he> in what order did Moses clothe them?—Y. Shek. V, 49ᵃ (expl. <he>פנחס המַלְבִּישׁ</he>, ib. V, 1, Mish. ed. <he>על המלבוש</he>) <he>שהיה מַלְבִּישׁ בגדי וכ׳</he> he invested (the appointed person) with (had in charge) the high priest’s garments; a. fr.
